Camera

Look around to find a clear view of your path.

Camera controls depend on your view mode. Centre the camera to return to your selected hero.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Controls (camera)

You have full control over of the camera throughout the game. You can turn it, move it, zoom in and out and follow a selected character. You'll also be able to see terrain and objects throughout the Game zone regardless of whether you've already explored them or not.

To move the camera simply move the cursor to the screen edge or use the arrow keys.
To turn the camera use the right mouse button or use the <CTRL> + arrow keys.
To zoom in/out move the mouse wheel or use the <PgUp>/<PgDn> keys.
To track a character double-click on the character's picture at the bottom of the screen, or press the <HOME> key.

Note: you're in the tracking mode when you see a symbol on top of the character's picture. If you manually move the camera, tracking stops.

Limited

You cannot zoom too far in or out, nor can you set the camera exactly horizontal or vertical. You can, however, get a very detailed view of something by pressing and holding down the <PgUp> key. This will let you zoom in further. When you release the key the camera will automatically return to the usual Maximum zoom value.
